name: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
summary: Clear Water Bay science, engineering and business university; the middle half of 2026 entrants had 35 to 41 IB points, bonus points included.

ib.text: No minimum total is set; the middle half of 2026 entrants had 35-41 points. Subjects are set per programme; IB English A needs grade 4 (English B: 4 at HL, 5 at SL). Your coordinator sends predicted grades.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Computer science taught by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering: programming, algorithms, operating systems and software engineering, then electives in AI, security, big data and more. A BEng in Artificial Intelligence is the sister major.
programmes.ib: Maths plus one of Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science; Physics or Computer Science preferred. Entry through the school-based route is competitive.
programmes.selectionNote: Apply to the department directly if sure of the major; joining it later through major selection has a tight quota. Interviews are held for some programmes.

flagshipSource.title: Computer Science (BEng/BSc): department of Computer Science and Engineering, big data, security and AI (programme page)

programmes.name: Quantitative Finance
programmes.about: A finance degree built on maths and statistics: derivative securities, investment analysis, portfolio management, quantitative trading and risk management, with one or two semesters of full-time internships at financial firms common.
programmes.ib: Maths is the subject asked for (HKUST's wording: senior level Mathematics).
programmes.selectionNote: Apply directly to the programme, or enter the business school without a major and apply after the first two or three terms. Interviews are held for some programmes.

flagshipSource.title: BSc in Quantitative Finance: an integrated curriculum from several schools with finance internships (programme page)

programmes.name: Business and Management
programmes.about: Enter the business school without a major: three terms of broad business foundations, then a choice from nine BBA majors and more. Around 70% of students add a second major or minor, and extended majors in AI, arts or sustainability exist.
programmes.ib: No specific subjects for school-based entry; majors such as Economics, Finance and Quantitative Finance ask for Maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Apply to the school without a major, or to a major directly. Interviews are held for some programmes.

flagshipSource.title: HKUST Business School: AACSB and EQUIS accredited, exchange agreements with 165+ institutions (school page)

faculties.name: School of Science
faculties.line: Science Group A needs Maths and Physics or Chemistry; Group B Maths and Chemistry or Biology; Biomedical and Health Sciences interviews.

faculties.name: School of Engineering
faculties.line: Maths plus Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science; apply to the school or straight to a department.

faculties.name: School of Business and Management
faculties.line: No set subjects for school-based entry; Economics, Finance and Quantitative Finance majors ask for Maths.

faculties.name: School of Humanities and Social Science
faculties.line: BSc in Global China Studies and in Quantitative Social Analysis; check each major's subject line in the IB admissions table.

faculties.name: Academy of Interdisciplinary Studies
faculties.line: Technology and Management, Environmental Management, Design and Technology; Maths and a science or Design Technology are often named.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: non-local tuition is HK$260,000 a year, and non-local students are given university accommodation in their first year.
After you submit, the application system emails your IB coordinator a form for predicted grades, so name them in the Academic Reference section.
HKUST lists the middle half of admitted students: 35 to 41 IB points for 2026 entry and 35 to 40 for 2025 and 2024, bonus points included.
